acceptanceCriteria: A test fails when the busy() guard is removed.
A test shows a sticky role keeps its tier after progress outside a session.
LOW-A is resolved or the owner's parkAfter decision is recorded with a test.
The 'model only in activity path' subtest asserts something that fails on the defect.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main 8a3e3a5b. PR #518 (#499 escalation ladder, ticket V1-0696) review findings. LOW-A: progress between sessions during cooldown resets the ladder but keeps the NoProgress backoff count, so the next no-progress session can park the ticket on the base model. This interacts with the open parkAfter owner question. LOW-B test gaps: (1) no test covers removing the busy() guard; (2) nothing checks that a sticky role keeps its tier after progress outside a session; (3) the 'model only in activity path' subtest is regression-only (cannot fail on the original defect). Expected: parking decisions on the base model require NoProgress evidence after the reset, or the owner records the intended behaviour; tests fail when the guard or sticky tier is removed. Actual: as described, per reviewer reading of the PR; not independently reproduced here.
title: Escalation ladder (#499/PR #518) review LOW-A/LOW-B: ladder reset keeps NoProgress count; test gaps
